info.name: CeylonTrip QA – API Test Cases
info.description: EC4206 group assignment. 20 API test cases from QA/Test_Cases.xlsx; each request is one sub-check (e.g. TC-TRIP-02a). One folder per member - run a whole folder: it starts with SETUP requests and is independent of the others. If any sub-check of a test case fails, mark that test case Fail. Select the 'CeylonTrip QA – Local' environment first.
